title: Aoyagi Toya — It's Invisible, But There〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, thanks for waiting.
Here's your blend.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much. I'll have it now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Your coffee really is delicious, MEIKO...
I feel refreshed already.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I appreciate you saying that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I heard that you all began taking English lessons. Sounds like quite a challenge...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes... We may be feeling a bit fatigued since we're still getting used to it, and we have a lot of assignments to complete.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But we need to do this if we're serious about performing overseas.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I can see that you're all doing your best.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
We are.
Oh, to change the subject...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This blend has a slightly different aroma to it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You noticed? I'm impressed.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I tried making a more soothing blend that will help you all relax after a tough English lesson.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
That certainly explains this mellow taste.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm glad I did this since you have a talent for noticing subtle differences in flavor.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Subtle differences in flavor...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. What you said just reminded me of something...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It happened a few days ago...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Thanks for agreeing to taste-test some of my coffee! I know things have been really busy for you lately.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's not a problem.
If anything, are you sure I'm the right person for this?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: You're a Weekend Garage regular and love the coffee here, right? That makes you the perfect person to ask!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Ken gave me his seal of approval, but I don't want to serve anything that isn't top quality...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mita...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: This place also means a lot to me, so I plan on doing everything I can as the interim manager.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: So, give me your honest opinion. Don't hold back.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay. Then, I'll do that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is good...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, there's a nice balance of sourness and bitterness. I also like the aroma.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This is remarkable, Mita.
You must've practiced quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Hehe. I did...!
I'm super relieved to hear you say that.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Now I'm glad that I worked hard to achieve the same flavor as Ken.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The same flavor as Ken...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, it's just... This coffee is certainly good, and very close to what Ken used to make.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But if someone were to ask me if it's exactly the same, then... I'm sorry, I'm not sure how to put it...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I see... Yeah, you would be able to tell since you're a regular here.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Thanks, Toya!
Would you mind taste-testing for me again after I've had a chance to practice more?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course. I'll be happy to help whenever.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see...
That really happened?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Mita appears to be working very hard to remain faithful to the recipes Ken taught him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then I began wondering why I was able to taste that difference. You could write that off by talking about experience and whatnot, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we put that to the test?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here you are.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Two cups of coffee...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd like for you to try both and tell me which one you prefer.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Understood.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Both are very good...
But I think I prefer this one.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I had a feeling.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Actually, both cups of coffee were made using the same beans.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
Is that true? They did taste the same overall, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This one was brewed with KAITO in mind, and that one is yours.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Every person likes to have their coffee taste a certain way, yes? That's why I brew everyone's coffee differently.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's incredible how small deviations in water temperature can lead to such varying results.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
I didn't realize you took such fine details into consideration.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That certainly explains why her coffee is so good.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I mean, she brews it specifically with me in mind.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Does that mean Ken did the same...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure he did.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Whether I was taking a break from practice or getting a breath of fresh air, I've always had access to good coffee...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've been able to make it this far because Ken and MEIKO have given me so much kindness and support.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'll tell Mita about this.
I'm sure he'll find it very helpful.
